+def test_make_date_string_module_level():

+
+
+def test_patron_check_ins_requires_id_and_update_content():

+    assert checkins.is_valid({'id': 1, 'year': 2024})

+    assert not checkins.is_valid({'year': 2024})
+    assert not checkins.is_valid({'id': 1, 'month': 2, 'day': 9})
+    assert not checkins.is_valid({'id': 1})
